q: Will Malaysia's planned carbon tax reduce the CBAM charge on Malaysian steel?
title: Malaysia carbon tax and the CBAM charge
short: Only once it is in force and actually paid on the emissions behind the goods. Malaysia has announced a carbon tax starting with iron, steel and energy. If the tax has rebates or a low rate, the deduction shrinks to what was effectively paid.
audience: Malaysian steel exporters and their EU importers

p: Article 9 of the CBAM Regulation allows a reduction for a carbon price effectively paid in the country of origin, net of any rebate or other compensation.

ul: Tax paid by the installation for the period, with official receipts.
The emissions the tax was charged on.
A calculation linking the tax to the tonnes of goods exported.

p: No deduction is possible for a tax that is announced but not yet charged. Plan pricing on the full CBAM charge and check the tax's final design when it is published.
